name: Composition hook into security-auth-magic-link mint surface
purpose: When security-auth-magic-link is applied alongside edge-cloudflare-turnstile, this hook registers the magic-link mint route under the Turnstile guard so a mint submit reads through the same token check. A missing or failed Turnstile response refuses the mint with 400 before the mint fires (AC-35105-1, AC-35105-2).
responsibilities: Register the magic-link mint route under the Turnstile guard at composition apply time.
Refuse a mint submit without a valid Turnstile token with 400 before the mint fires.
Emit a mint-refused event record with the same {sitekeyHash, outcome, timestamp} shape as any other guard refusal.
internalStructure: A thin registration hook that wraps the shipped magic-link mint handler with the Turnstile guard middleware. In the pack fixture the wiring is a one-line composeWithMagicLink({guard, mintHandler}) invocation on the route registration.

interfaces.name: composeWithMagicLink
interfaces.summary: Register the magic-link mint route under the Turnstile guard.
